Trade Operations Professional with 5.7 years of experience in Investment Banking & Capital Markets Operations specializing in Core Trade 
Settlements, Trade Lifecycle Management, Trade Support, Reconciliation, Break Resolution, and Securities Operations across Equities, Fixed 
Income, FX, and Derivatives (ETD). Experienced in cash & position reconciliations, settlement fail management, STP improvement, operational 
risk control, SLA compliance, and audit support. 
 
Domain:  Investment Banking & Capital Markets Operations, Trade Operations, Trade Lifecycle, Trade Settlements & Securities, SLA 
Compliance, Audit Support, Post Trade Settlement, Trade Processing & Trade Support, Reconciliation (Cash, Position, Trade) 
Asset Classes:  Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD), CDO / Loan Syndication, Fixed Income, OTC Derivatives, Equities, SWIFT, Bonds, 
Trade, Custody, Corporate Actions, Trade Lifecycle, Commodities, Trade Delivery, Affirmation and Confirmation, Failed Trade Tracking, 
Currency Balancing Monitoring, Depository and Custody Review, Static Data  Reference Data, Trade Booking & Validation 
:  MCH, Intelimatch, D-Hub, Advanced Excel, SWIFT Messaging, DTCC, Euroclear, Clearstream, MS-Word, 
Bloomberg 
 
 
WORK EXPERIENCE  
Associate - Cognizant                                                                                                                                              June 2023 -Present 
• Execute and monitor trade settlements across multiple settlement platforms, ensuring all transactions are processed accurately and in line 
with client agreements and trade obligations.  
• Used Bloomberg Terminal to retrieve and verify market prices for securities using CUSIP identifiers. 
• Ensure timely settlement of securities and cash through systems such as Euroclear, Clearstream, DTC, while adhering to market deadlines 
and SLAs. Perform trade matching and confirmation with internal systems, custodians, and counterparties to ensure all trade details are 
accurately aligned before settlement.  
• Investigate, analyze, and resolve settlement discrepancies and trade breaks between internal records, custodians, and external 
counterparties, ensuring complete reconciliation.  
• Ensure all unsettled or failed trades are tracked, escalated where necessary, and resolved within defined operational SLAs.  
• Act as a point of contact for clients, traders, custodians, and internal stakeholders for trade-related queries, confirmations, and issue 
resolution. Provide high-quality client servicing by responding to inquiries in a timely, professional manner and ensuring transparency in 
settlement status and issues.  
• Support business identification and participate as a subject matter expert in discussions related to process improvements, system 
enhancements, and operational efficiencies.  
• Identify operational risks, process gaps, and recurring settlement issues; recommend and help implement process improvements to reduce 
trade breaks and increase efficiency.  
• Maintain accurate records of all trade lifecycle activities, ensuring audit readiness and compliance with internal controls and regulatory 
requirements.  
• Collaborate with senior stakeholders, trading desks, operations teams, and technology teams to ensure smooth end-to-end settlement 
processing 
Achievements:  
Received recognition and appreciation from clients and senior management for accurate trade processing and timely issue 
resolution. 
 
Consultant - Deloitte                                                                                                                                            Aug 2022– May 2023 
• Managed post-market FX trade reconciliation, ensuring all positions are accurately booked and settled. 
• Reconciled GBS Spot Position (SPOS) breaks and internal trade suspense/clearance accounts, identifying and resolving discrepancies. 
• Conducted break itemization and analysis, reviewing nature of breaks and implementing corrective actions. 
• Allocated work, reviewed pending breaks, and managed escalated break resolutions in coordination with relevant teams. 
• Performed middle-office reconciliation for in-house clearance accounts within Barclays. 
• Executed front-office to back-office and back-office to back-office reconciliations across internal accounts. 
• Handled end-to-end FX break processing across multiple account types, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution. 
• Led an ad-hoc project to set up correct Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), updating 3000+ CP-SSI instructions to enable STP (Straight-
Through Processing) and ensure fast, accurate fund transfers via clearing/agent banks to ultimate beneficiaries.

• Managed End-to-End Trade Booking & Reconciliation ensuring SLA compliance  
• Accurate Trade & Cash Accounting Entries with proper documentation  
• Performed Cash & Position Reconciliation with brokers/counterparties  
• Handled Query Resolution & Break Management across teams  
• Resolved reconciliation breaks ensuring timely closure  
• Identified & escalated Operational Risk issues  
• Supported Audit requirements & reporting (Error Tracker, Break Log)  
• Delivered Month/Quarter-End activities within tight deadline. 
• Supported Client Servicing, Audit Requirements, and Knowledge Transfer for new joiners
